arguments.Prompt: Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy game character animation sheet on uniform vivid solid MAGENTA background (#FF00FF). Exactly 3 columns by 2 rows (3x2 grid), containing 6 complete poses of the same character. Reference-1.png provides the exact character identity, headwear, layered garments, and gnarled stone staff. Reference-2.png is for the painterly digital dark fantasy rendering style only. Character: Older powerful man with deep brown skin and thick short greying beard, broad pale ochre hooded shoulder wrap over ivory layered cloth, stone charms and leather pouches, holding a heavy gnarled staff with an angular stone head, with small floating stone motes and compact dust. Perspective and angle: Elevated 55-degree orthographic camera. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view for ALL poses, with head and torso turned diagonally away from the viewer towards image-right so the viewer sees the back surfaces and hooded back. Never facing the viewer. The 6 defensive resistance poses in order across the cells: ready guard stance, feet bracing, hands and staff lifting forward to block, torso leaning forward into resistance, slightly recoiling from impact while keeping guard, steady forward guard hold. Each cell contains one complete figure at identical anatomical scale within the middle 60% of the cell, with wide completely empty magenta gutters. No panel borders, no grid lines, no text, no labels, no ground shadows, no glowing auras. Pure solid magenta background.
